title: The aim
text: Collect all nine cards of one commodity by trading with everyone at once. That is a corner. The first player to five hundred points wins.

title: Setting up
text: Use one commodity for each player and put the rest away. Shuffle and deal the whole deck out, nine cards each. Give everyone a moment to decide what to collect.

title: Trading
text:
When the dealer opens the market, everybody trades at the same time. Hold out one to four cards of the same commodity, face down, and call out how many. Swap with anyone calling the same number. Nobody says what they are offering.

There are no turns. It is supposed to be loud.

title: The corner
text: The moment you hold nine of one commodity, ring the bell and call your corner. The round stops. You score the number printed on that commodity's cards.

title: The Bull and the Bear
text:
These two are optional. With them in, two players start with ten cards. The Bull is wild: it can stand in for the ninth card of a corner. The Bear is only trouble.

When the round ends, anyone left holding the Bull or the Bear loses twenty points for each. You cannot call a corner while holding the Bear.

title: Keeping score
text: Tap a name to add five points. The Tap button switches to taking away, for the Bear.
